title: oscore clone housekeeping: dead non-compiled sibling modules hold divergent pre-port API copies
description: Found by 3x codereview of the rust-oscore observe port (9liz unblock work). /home/mark/crates/oscore/src/ contains unprotect.rs, context.rs, protect.rs, crypto.rs, option.rs, types.rs, tests.rs, group.rs that are NOT declared in lib.rs (only error, seqnum, edhoc, tests are) and reference crate::context::/crate::types:: paths that do not exist - dead files from an abandoned modular refactor. They differ semantically from the live lib.rs (unprotect.rs checks response PIVs with is_replay at L199 and lacks the empty-payload rejection), so anyone auditing the observe API from the directory listing reads the wrong implementation, and anyone 'restoring' the modules while fixing ythw breaks the build. Action: delete or archive them in the clone when the observe work lands (clone is machine-local; the deletion does not touch the lichen workspace).
